ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Jackpot.cs:22-25) == cost 3 / ATTACK / RARE / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(25m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(3)` (Jackpot.cs:16-20) == both numbers, both declared.

OnPlay.issue: Order, filter and the upgrade-the-generated-cards branch are all faithful. Attack first (Jackpot.cs:30-32), then generation. The filter is transcribed exactly, including the subtle part: C# tests `energyCost.Canonical == 0 && !energyCost.CostsX` (Jackpot.cs:35-37) -- the CANONICAL cost, not the current one, so a card discounted this turn does not qualify -- and the sim reads `_CARD_CLASSES[cid]()._energy_cost` off a FRESH instance (colorless_attacks.py:244), which is the canonical value, plus the same `energy_cost_x` exclusion. The upgrade branch matches too: `if (IsUpgraded) CardCmd.Upgrade(item)` BEFORE the pile add (Jackpot.cs:40-44) == `if self.upgrade_level > 0 and new_card.is_upgradable: new_card.upgrade()` before `add_to_hand`, and C#'s `CardCmd.Upgrade` self-checks IsUpgradable (CardCmd.cs:270-273) so the sim's explicit test is equivalent. The generation is `GetForCombat` -- WITH replacement, so duplicates are allowed -- and the sim's per-card `_rng.choice` reproduces that shape. WRONG RNG STREAM: C# names `Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration`; the sim draws on the unseeded shared `combat._rng` even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` maps to `combat_card_generation` (combat_rng.py:20,52), and `random_pool_cards` uses `rng.sample` / `rng.choice` (pool.py:157-161) rather than the game's draw sequence, so the number of draws differs too. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/discovery's and card/distraction's OnPlay entries (rule 3). LIVE, and this card is one of the 21 the `shared-rng` probe lists. card/infernal_blade in this same batch shows the correct shape: branch on `crng.is_parity` and use `crng.card_gen`. REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py:33` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (run.py:1146-1148, combat.py:88), so a `ctx.combat._rng` draw taken from inside a card's `on_play` is recorded and fails the gate -- verified by playing this family's shape under a `Tripwire` and getting a hit at the `card.on_play` frame (combat.py:490). The gate is green today, so these 20 seeds never reach this card's draw; routing the site to the named `combat_rng` accessor is verified by keeping it green.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(5m)` (Jackpot.cs:50) == `self._damage += 5` (25 -> 30). The CARDS var stays 3 when upgraded -- the upgrade's second effect is the free upgrade of the generated cards, which lives in OnPlay, not in a var change. Both checked.
